title: Crusoe says Google has bought out its data center site in southeast Wyoming; Crusoe reportedly failed to lock in customers including Google for the project (Lynn Doan/Bloomberg)
summary: Lynn Doan / Bloomberg: Crusoe says Google has bought out its data center site in southeast Wyoming; Crusoe reportedly failed to lock in customers including Google for the project — Alphabet Inc.'s Google has bought out Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, opting to take on the project itself …
